name: Lesson 2 · First air
intro: Speed, then the lip. Compress as you climb, explode as you hit it.

goals.hint: Crouch as you climb (both sticks down), then flick both up right at the lip — that is your pop
goals.hintClassic: Pump for speed, hold Space (A) while steering up the face, release at the lip

goals.hint: In the air, hold K (B) with a stick direction for a grab. Let go before you land
Land with your legs loaded (sticks down) — a crouched landing forgives a lot more than a locked-out one
goals.hintClassic: Land square to the wave: inside 20° is Perfect, past 45° is a wipeout
